svg.title: Calling an Agent from an App
svg.desc: Sequence between three participants: the app back end, the Foundry project reached with AIProjectClient, and the agent. The app authenticates with DefaultAzureCredential, Microsoft Entra ID, not an API key. It gets the agent with agents.get by name. It calls responses.create on the OpenAI client with an agent_reference in extra_body, and the agent returns output_text. A follow-up passes the same conversation ID, so the reply keeps context. An option using threads.runs.create describes the retired Assistants API, not Foundry Agent Service.
svg.text: Calling an Agent from an App
Authenticate with Entra ID, name the agent with an agent reference, keep one conversation per user.
Retired Assistants API: not Foundry Agent Service
